build_scene_bvh: build a global BVH for all geometries in all worlds using warp
build_mesh_bvh: build a warp mesh BVH from mesh vertex and face data
build_hfield_bvh: build a warp mesh BVH from heightfield data with greedy mesh optimization
build_flex_bvh: build a warp mesh BVH for a single 2D or 3D flex element
refit_bvh: refit dynamic BVH structures in the render context for scene and flex geometries
